initial_prompt: Write a Python script to scrape the titles of the top 10 posts from 'news.ycombinator.com'.

messages.content: Write a Python script to scrape the titles of the top 10 posts from 'news.ycombinator.com'.

### Dependencies ```bash pip install requests beautifulsoup4 ``` ### Script ```python import requests from bs4 import BeautifulSoup def scrape_hn_titles(limit=10): url = "https://news.ycombinator.com/" try: # User-Agent header prevents basic bot blocking response = requests.get(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}) response.raise_for_status() soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser') # Select title links. Structure: Title title_elements = soup.select('span.titleline > a') # Extract text and slice the top 'limit' titles = [tag.get_text() for tag in title_elements[:limit]] return titles except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: print(f"Error fetching data: {e}") return [] if __name__ == "__main__": top_titles = scrape_hn_titles() print(f"--- Top {len(top_titles)} Hacker News Titles ---") for idx, title in enumerate(top_titles, 1): print(f"{idx}. {title}") ```
